name: Dripping Paint Finish
description: A treatment rather than a face: whatever capitals are set, they are finished in wet paint that has run, with thin drips leaving the baseline and stopping partway down.
phrase: lettering finished as freshly applied wet paint in a single flat colour, the surface glossy and slightly uneven with visible brush loading, thin runs leaving the baseline of several letters and travelling straight down before thinning to a point and stopping partway, one or two drips carrying a small bead at the tip, the paint pooling very slightly where a run begins, with no outline, no bevel, no glow and no drop shadow
